title: PRODUCTX multiplies the non-blank values and returns a double

source.quote: PRODUCTX ignores blank expressions, the multiplication operator does not.
source.supports: a BLANK does not turn the product into BLANK

source.quote: Only the numbers in the column are counted. Blanks, logical values, and text are ignored.
source.supports: same; the return value is a decimal number

derivation: 2 * 3 * -4 = -24, skipping the BLANK. Both pages give the return type as a decimal number (double), also for integer input.
